i.norm: Verifies that getFirstEnum returns the first enum constant when the ToIntFunction matches the target value for all constants in the enum. Locale.FilteringMode constants in declaration order: AUTOSELECT_FILTERING, EXTENDED_FILTERING, IGNORE_EXTENDED_RANGES, MAP_EXTENDED_RANGES, REJECT_EXTENDED_RANGES The mock always returns 3 (== targetValue), so the first constant AUTOSELECT_FILTERING is the first match and must be returned.
Mock always returns targetValue regardless of which FilteringMode is passed
Because the mock matches every constant, the first one (AUTOSELECT_FILTERING) is returned
